pages.title: Getting Hitched
pages.text: Learn to change a train consist; track and casing support your own shunting yard.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Align bogey centers over both coupler points and orient carriages consistently. A wrench changes orientation; a signal starts the admissible operation.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Power a Coupling Block beside the relevant train setup. Connect or disconnect trains.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Occupy both coupler track points with bogey centers aligned and carriages facing the same direction; use a Wrench to reorient when needed. Make the selected coupling/decoupling action admissible.
